message.content: [罪名]非法捕猎、收购、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine applicable criminal charges under Chinese law.

Facts: From 2015-8 to 2016-8, defendant Tang captured over 200 black water chickens (black water chicken, Gallinula chloropus) using illegal methods (sticky net, playing music to attract) in a rice field. These are protected wildlife (three "有" animals: beneficial, important economic or scientific value). He sold them to someone else (who was sentenced separately). Illegal profit about 700 yuan. He was summoned and confessed.

Thus the crime is illegal hunting/poaching of protected wildlife. Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 338 (maybe) about illegal hunting, killing, trading protected wildlife. The specific crime: "非法捕猎、收购、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪" or "非法捕猎、收购、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪". Also possibly "非法买卖国家重点保护野生动物罪". The facts: He captured and sold. So the crime is "非法捕猎、收购、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪". Also maybe "非法捕猎罪"? But Chinese law has specific article: Article 338 of Criminal Law: "非法捕猎、收购、出售国家重点保护的野生动物或者利用、运输、走私、提供帮助的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金或者没收财产。" So the appropriate charge is "非法捕猎、收购、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪". Could also be "非法捕猎罪"? But the law lumps them.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法捕猎、收购、出售国家重点保护野生动物罪<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: He used sticky net, which is a prohibited hunting method. That is covered under the same. No other crimes like smuggling, etc. So single charge.

Thus final answer.
